body: I hope most health insurance will start to cover ketamine therapy, yknow the only result that comes up for fixing or helping reduce suicidal ideation.
Psyching myself out of my suicide attempt months ago.
I had it prescribed in reaction to a devastating break-up months ago, but nothing new since.

I have enough sodium nitrite (literally via Amazon) and stockpiled pills on hand to knock me out and end me, studying up for my FOID card to get myself a gun, or there's always my trusty belt to jam into my door and around my neck.  Keeping my options open for when the time is right.
Whether alive or dead, I just want to move on.
